messages:
Alex: noticed p99 jump for /v1/stream in Endpoints > Percentiles at ~02:03 UTC. p50/p95 normal, p99 +40%. anyone else see a tail-only spike?
Priya: which filters and window? region/model?
Alex: Console -> Observability -> Latency -> Endpoints. region=us-east, model=redwood-13b, window=5m centered 02:00-02:05. link: https://console/redwood/latency?endpoint=%2Fv1%2Fstream
Dan: quick glance: routing policy tweak rolled at 01:58 reduced primary pool weight, some traffic fell through to pool:legacy-slow. that explains tail-only p99.
Maya: infra logs show quota_fallbacks at 02:02 for tenant=alpha-shop. snippet: ```{"ts":"2026-04-05T02:02:18Z","tenant":"alpha-shop","route":"api-realtime","decision":"fallback","target":"pool:legacy-slow","reason":"quota_exceeded"}```
Alex: are percentiles in Console from merged t-digests or naive per-origin merges? that matters for tail attribution.
Priya: backend merges t-digests across telemetry shards (so math is correct). problem is UI hides sample_origin by default so the single p99 hides origin skew.
Dan: also sampling fractions differ by proxy. if legacy-slow briefly sampled more, p99 will be overrepresented. we should surface sample_count.
Maya: UX fixes: 1) add total_sample_count next to p50/p95/p99; 2) show top-origin badges in hover; 3) add a one-click drilldown that reruns percentiles partitioned by sample_origin.
Alex: agree. short-term we need sample_count + origin badge + low-sample warning. that should reduce incident noise.
Priya: I'll open a small PR for tooltip + drilldown link + low-sample hint. ETA today EOD.
Dan: alerting note: suppress endpoint p99 alerts when sample_count < 100 or when top_origin_percent < 20% to avoid noisy alerts from tiny origin tails.
Maya: will include the low-sample badge and a link to "Partition by origin" in the PR. also add the small tooltip explaining "percentiles computed from merged t-digests; drill down by sample_origin for tail attribution."
telemetry-bot: telemetry-service v1.10 deployed at 2026-04-05T01:40:00Z (sha: e7f9a2b) :gear:
Alex: plan: Priya PR lands, Dan updates alert suppression, Maya verifies sample counts for 01:55-02:10, I'll notify CS if customers report regressions.
Priya: noted. will tag this thread with PR link when ready.
Dan: I'll run raw sample export for 01:55-02:10 and post numbers.
Maya: thanks. once PR merges we'll re-evaluate p99 and consider rolling back the weight change if tail persists. :thumbsup:
